items.t: Snap (SNAP) Endorses Defiance Act As Deepfake Rules Reach Social Platforms
items.sum: Snap (NYSE:SNAP) has publicly endorsed the Defiance Act, proposed federal legislation targeting AI-generated deepfake pornography. The measure has drawn broad bipartisan backing in Congress along with support from digital rights and anti-abuse advocacy groups. items.t: Snap (SNAP) Settles Major Youth Addiction Lawsuits With 1,600 Claims Still Active
items.sum: Snap (NYSE:SNAP) has reached undisclosed settlements in major lawsuits claiming its app design fostered addictive use and mental health harms among minors. The agreements resolve some of the highest profile cases against Snap but leave more than 1,600 claims active from families and school districts across the United States. items.t: Snap: User Growth, ARPU Gains Create Upside Catalysts
items.sum: The bull case for Snap: shares look underpriced at 1.2x forward sales as North American ARPU rose 20% and adjusted EBITDA and FCF margins expanded.
